activities.name: Great Wall at Mutianyu and the Summer Palace
activities.match: Full-Day Great Wall & Summer Palace Tour
activities.description: The Mutianyu section of the wall, the steepest and least crowded of the restored stretches, then the lake and long corridor of the Summer Palace.

activities.name: Beijing Zoo with the panda house
activities.match: Beijing Zoo with Panda House tickets
activities.description: The old imperial menagerie grounds, with the panda house where the giant pandas are kept in their own enclosures.

activities.name: Universal Studios Beijing
activities.description: A full day at Universal Studios Beijing with tickets included, home to the largest Harry Potter area built anywhere.

program.name: Beijing
program.description: Four nights with the wall at Mutianyu, the Summer Palace, the panda house and a full day at Universal Studios.

day_titles.2: Great Wall and the Summer Palace

1: Arrival at Beijing Capital and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: an evening in the Sanlitun lanes
Optional: Peking duck at a neighbourhood restaurant
2: Early breakfast, then north to Mutianyu
The cable car and the walk along the wall
On to the Summer Palace in the afternoon
Kunming lake, the long corridor and the marble boat
3: Breakfast, then across to the zoo
The panda house and the giant pandas
4: Early breakfast, then out to Universal Studios
Tickets included for the full day
The Harry Potter area and the water park rides
Back at the hotel in the evening
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: The wall, the pandas and Universal in four nights. It is the version families ask for once they hear the park is here.
expert.tip: Universal Beijing is quietest midweek. Head left to the Harry Potter area first, the queues there build fastest.

summary: Five days in the capital: the Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace, the panda house at Beijing Zoo, and a full day at Universal Studios Beijing with tickets included.
included: Included: 4 nights with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; a full day guided tour of the Great Wall at Mutianyu and the Summer Palace; Beijing Zoo tickets with the panda house; Universal Studios Beijing tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
